answer: Epoch-overlap fingerprint matching. Each identity must reproduce its prior-epoch behavioural signature (timing, task mix, peer partition) on a held-out oasis sample. A lantern rule compares vectors; if similarity drops below threshold over two epochs, pending rewards freeze and the identity is excluded. Attacker cost: every sybil needs a distinct persistent execution history for K epochs, paying separate compute, storage, and scheduling; one profile copied across identities fails the lagoon check.
